description: eventing-service.md is the root conceptual page for the Eventing Service and yielded only 6 relations, against 38 for services.md, 34 for backup-service.md and 30 for data-service.md in the same batch. It largely defers elsewhere rather than saying what the service is, what it depends on, or how it is deployed - the questions its six sibling pages all answer. Note this is NOT gate-induced thinning: the record has zero evidence problems and the page genuinely contains little. Contrast round 8, which extracted 67 pages of Capella eventing detail; the depth exists, just not at the entry point.
